format: Markdown with embedded documentation and technical specifications
description: This file contains detailed documentation for the HDMIOutput HAL interface, including overview, functional capabilities, interfaces, implementation requirements, resource management, data flow sequences, capabilities, and system integration details. It is intended as a comprehensive guide rather than executable code.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the supported video formats, pixel formats, colorimetry, HDCP versions, HDR modes, and other capabilities of the HDMI output port.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enumerates the states of HDCP authentication process.

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Defines the various HDR output modes supported by the HDMI port.

classes.name: SPDSource
classes.description: Enumerates the types of SPD InfoFrame sources.

classes.name: VIC
classes.description: Defines HDMI Video ID Codes representing specific video modes.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the HDMI output, including supported resolutions, color spaces, HDR modes, and more.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific property, such as VIC or content type, on the HDMI output controller.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and activates the HDMI output with current configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Deactivates the HDMI output, stopping signal transmission.
